title: Proper fibre idempotents come from the pushforward stalk
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $s\in S$, and let $e\in H^0(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$ be an idempotent on the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Then $e$ lies in the image of $(f_*\mathcal O_X)_s\to H^0(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 21.16.1 (Tag 0G7X), statement and proof lines 8117--8179

proof.text: Descend the idempotent and the fibre projection to a proper locally Noetherian model after restricting to an affine open neighbourhood W of s. Retain the maps p,r,a,q and their commuting identities.
Apply the locally Noetherian lifting theorem to g and e₀ at r(s), obtaining V, t and the equality of its fibre restriction with e₀.

Put U=W.ι(r⁻¹V). The commuting square identifies the image of p⁻¹(g⁻¹V) under the open immersion f⁻¹W→X with f⁻¹U. Use the inverse of the open-immersion section isomorphism to transport p*(t) to Γ(X,f⁻¹U). The image of the original fibre lies above s∈U. The identities a followed by the inclusion = f.fiberι and q followed by g.fiberι = ap, together with appLE composition, identify the restriction of the transported section with q*(e₀)=e.
